A minimum of 1 year of experienceExperience working in a maintenance, custodial, or janitorial role within a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

Under the general supervision of the Custodial Supervisor, the incumbent is responsible for the cleaning of UC Irvine facilities. These duties will include but not be limited to: daily floor care, dusting, bathroom cleaning and disinfecting kitchen cleaning, cleaning of fixtures and furniture, interior and exterior trash removal, window cleaning, and additional tasks as necessary (i.e. furniture moving) to ensure all facilities are maintained at a high level of cleanliness. Responsibilities may include weekend work during open and closing and during peak work periods, and may also include after-hours emergency response and cleaning.
Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
Bi-lingual Spanish/English.
Must be able to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing for the purpose of instructions, record keeping and communicating issues with students and staff.
Must be able to operate a Facilities Management vehicle
Must be able to work outside regularly scheduled shift.
Must Pass a Background check
Ability to vacuum, mop, dust, wash walls, wash windows and other surfaces
Ability to clean sinks, showers, and toilets.
Ability to use vacuum, mop and pail, and other related equipment.
Knowledge of the correct and safe use of proper cleaning supplies.
Ability to understand and follow instructions
